description: Schema for the authenticated authority state — the fully resolved actor identity, authentication outcome, execution eligibility, observation authority, and authority provenance produced at the authority boundary before execution begins

actor_id.description: Fully qualified identifier of the actor whose authority was evaluated

authenticated.description: Whether the actor's identity was successfully authenticated

authentication_mechanism.description: V0: 'static_identity' — mechanism used; extensible for PKI/JWT in future phases without redesign

identity_claims.description: Resolved identity claims from the authentication process; structure is mechanism-dependent and opaque to execution

execution_authority.description: Execution eligibility: what this actor is authorized to execute

authorized_workflows.description: Explicit list of workflow FQDNs the actor is authorized to invoke; wildcards are forbidden

observation_authority.description: Observation eligibility: what this actor is authorized to observe — distinct from execution authority

visibility_scope.description: Projection visibility constraints: what output projections and TE results the actor may receive

trace_scope.description: Trace visibility constraints: what execution trace data the actor may access

authority_provenance.description: Provenance chain for this authority state: source, evaluation timestamp, and chain of authority — the foundation of non-repudiation

source.description: Authority source identifier (e.g., authority registry path or authority issuer)

evaluated_at.description: Timestamp when authority was evaluated at the boundary

failure_reason.description: If authenticated is false: the reason authentication failed; absent if authenticated is true

constraints: If authenticated is false, failure_reason MUST be present
If authenticated is true, failure_reason MUST be absent
execution_authority.authorized_workflows entries MUST use FQDN format
Wildcard workflow grants are a constitutional violation
This state is immutable once produced — execution consumes it without mutation
Authentication mechanisms terminate before runtime traversal begins
